test_cases.title: Verify successful login and adding Sauce Labs Backpack to cart from inventory page
steps: Locate the 'Sauce Labs Backpack' item on the inventory page
Click the 'Add to cart' button for the Sauce Labs Backpack
test_cases.expected_result: User is logged in successfully, button text changes to 'Remove', and the shopping cart badge displays '1'

test_cases.title: Verify adding Sauce Labs Backpack to cart from product details page
steps: Click on the 'Sauce Labs Backpack' product title or image to open details page
test_cases.expected_result: Product details page loads, button changes to 'Remove', and cart badge shows '1'

test_cases.title: Verify Sauce Labs Backpack persists in cart page after addition
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
Click the shopping cart icon in the top right corner
test_cases.expected_result: Cart page opens and displays 'Sauce Labs Backpack' with quantity 1 and correct price

test_cases.title: Verify user cannot add item to cart when login fails with invalid credentials
test_cases.expected_result: User remains on login page, error message is displayed, and inventory/cart is inaccessible

test_cases.title: Verify locked out user cannot login to add Sauce Labs Backpack
test_cases.expected_result: Error message 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.' is displayed, and user cannot access inventory
